title: 第一卷 第28章 少爷一定有底牌！
content_zh:
秦绝微笑道：“原本我以为李家主只是有点小聪明，现在看来，李家主是有大智慧的。既然你愿意留下，那便留下吧，外面的那些人，应该用不着。”

    王家大部分强者，都被韩家的人杀了，李东明安排的三十人，对付一般武者还行，和灵山宗的人硬拼，那和送死无疑。

    “老朽儿一切听从秦少吩咐。”李东明作礼笑道。

    “一边歇着吧，等他们来便是了。小青，你将门敞开着，便去后院歇着吧。”秦绝吩咐道。

    “好的，少爷。”

    小青打开门没多久，韩汐的身影，就从外面匆匆跑进来，原本精致的俏脸，此刻有些慌张。

    “少爷，灵山宗的人进城了，现在已经去了谢家。”韩汐颤声道。

    秦绝笑道：“那你还跑回来作甚，不应该躲远点吗？”

    韩汐咬了咬红唇，眼里有些水雾浮升：“少爷就是这般想汐儿的吗？”

    “怎么还哭上了，逗你的。你既然回来了，就去后院安排人烧点热水吧，一会儿要是动起手来，难免会溅我一身血，我得好好洗上一番。”秦绝淡笑道。

    韩汐忙道：“少爷，我回来不是要给你烧热水的，是想让你使人去韩家一趟，将我爷爷喊过来帮忙的。我……我到底是韩家人，不好直接派人去韩家。而且由少爷亲自使人去，韩家必然不敢拒绝。”

    一边李东明眉头微掀，这韩家的女儿，到底是不是韩风亲生的啊？这胳膊肘真会往外拐。

    此刻的韩家，恐怕是掩耳装聋，对秦府之事避之不及呢。

    一旦使人过去，韩家就必须表态和站队了。

    秦绝笑道：“没想到灵山宗送给我第一份惊喜，竟是你们二人。韩家不用去，你照我说的做，去后院烧水吧。”

    李东明咧嘴一笑，看来他的忠心，少爷是看见了。

    韩汐闻言，也只得无奈道：“看来少爷心里有底，那汐儿就不多言了。”

    韩汐刚走没一会，洪铁虎便肃然的带着那些徒弟，走了过来。

    “你怎么带着他们过来了？”秦绝淡笑道。

    “回少爷，听说府上会有一些麻烦。属下的伤势，已经恢复了大半，已有一战之力！”洪铁虎郑重道。

    秦绝淡笑道：“都回去，我带你们回来，不是让你们白白送死的。等你们将来真有了一些实力，再表忠心不迟。”

    洪铁虎张口还想再说什么，秦绝眼神一冷：“回去！”

    洪铁虎只得苦笑抱拳：“是。”

    李东明眼中闪过一道异彩。

    别家的主子，都是希望手下能够为了主子拼上性命。
content_en:
Qin Jue smiled and said: "Originally, I thought that the Li family leader was just a little smart, but now it seems that the Li family leader has great wisdom. Since you are willing to stay, then stay, the people outside should not be needed."

Most of the powerful men of the Wang family were killed by the Han family. The thirty people arranged by Li Dongming were okay against ordinary warriors, but if they fought against the Lingshan Sect's people, they would definitely end up dead.

"I will obey Mr. Qin's instructions." Li Dongming said with a smile.

"Just rest and wait for them to come. Xiaoqing, leave the door open and go to the backyard to rest." Qin Jue ordered.

"Okay, Master."

Not long after Xiaoqing opened the door, Han tide's figure hurried in from outside. His originally delicate and pretty face was now a little panicked.

"Young Master, the people from the Lingshan Sect have entered the city and have now gone to the Xie family." Han tide said in a trembling voice.

Qin Jue smiled and said: "Then why are you running back? Shouldn't you stay away?"

Han tide bit his red lips, with mist rising in his eyes: "Is this how the young master misses Xi'er?"

"Why are you still crying? I'm kidding you. Now that you're back, go to the backyard and arrange for someone to boil some hot water. If you move your hands later, blood will inevitably be splashed all over me. I'll have to wash myself off." Qin Jue said with a smile.

Han tide said hurriedly: "Master, I came back not to boil hot water for you, but to ask you to send someone to the Han family and call my grandfather to help. I... I am a Han family member after all, so it is not good for me to send people to the Han family directly. And if the young master sends people there himself, the Han family will not dare to refuse."

Li Dongming raised his eyebrows slightly. Is this Han family's daughter Han Feng's biological child?This elbow really turns out.

At this moment, the Han family is probably pretending to be deaf and avoiding the affairs of the Qin Mansion.

Once people are allowed to pass, the Han family must take a stand and stand in line.

Qin Jue smiled and said: "I didn't expect that the first surprise that Lingshan Sect gave me would be you two. You don't need to go to the Han family. Just do as I said and go to the backyard to boil water."

Li Dongming grinned. It seemed that the young master had seen his loyalty.

When Han tide heard this, he had no choice but to say: "It seems that the young master is confident in his heart, so Xi'er won't say anything more."

Not long after Han tide left, Hong Tiehu came over with his disciples solemnly.

"Why did you bring them here?" Qin Jue said with a faint smile.

"Back to the young master, I heard that there will be some trouble at home. Most of my subordinate's injuries have recovered and he is ready to fight!" Hong Tiehu said solemnly.

Qin Jue smiled lightly and said: "Go back, I brought you back, not to let you die in vain. When you really have some strength in the future, it will not be too late to show your loyalty."

Hong Tiehu opened his mouth to say something else, but Qin Jue's eyes turned cold: "Go back!"

Hong Tiehu could only smile bitterly and clasp his fists: "Yes."

A strange light flashed in Li Dongming's eyes.

The masters of other families all hope that their subordinates will risk their lives for their masters.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 28 The young master must have a trump card!
